subject.title: Core hardening tracker: converge duplicated runtime invariants onto single owners

question: Which remaining duplicate-ownership seams should be sponsored as near-term core hardening slices?
rationale: The protected umbrella spans several permanent owner boundaries and explicitly states that listing a seam is not blanket approval to implement every row.

options.title: Sponsor risk-ordered slices
options.body: Continue one independently reviewed seam per PR, prioritizing observable drift, session correctness, and lifecycle risk.

options.title: Narrow to observed regressions
options.body: Retain only seams with demonstrated behavioral drift and defer lower-priority type-shape or maintainability cleanup.

options.title: End the umbrella tracker
options.body: Close the roadmap after completed slices and require every future seam to establish standalone sponsorship and evidence.

recommendation.title: Sponsor risk-ordered slices
recommendation.body: Continue one independently reviewed seam per PR, prioritizing observable drift, session correctness, and lifecycle risk.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest program-specific history and can route each proposed slice to the relevant current area owner.
